ficha_publicada.complicacoes: Bully: Doctor Light receives gratification from the humiliation and suffering of others, especially women and those who are not consenting to his will. Light-Dependence: Doctor Light’s powers require ambient light, suffering a Weakness effect in reduced light exposure. The Gamemaster determines the effect’s rank, as suits lighting levels. The powers don’t work at all in total darkness. Something to Prove: Doctor Light can be driven into a rage if sufficiently mocked, belittled, or if his immense self-doubt is otherwise enflamed.
